brief: Prioritise pre-event attention for this ageing unit to address its reduced margin against mechanical failure ahead of the heat event as outlined in MG-023. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, drawing also on MG-023. Ensure any outstanding vegetation or obstruction defects are cleared with priority since clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity as specified in SOP-011.
